desc: Derive and verify edge-on-path probabilities for random recursive tree: p_k = 0 (k>v), 1 (k=v), 1/k (u<k<v), 1-1/u (k=u), 2(k-1)/(k(k+1)) (k<u); confirmed by induction proof that Pr[k common ancestor of a,b] = 2/(k(k+1)) and by hand-enumeration for N=4
Validate formula against Samples 1 and 2 by hand (both match: 2, 3 and 100)

Implement the complete solution: precompute modular inverses inv[1..N+1] via the linear recurrence, prefix sums C[x] = Σ_{k=2..x} A_k·2(k-1)·inv(k)·inv(k+1) and B[x] = Σ_{k=2..x} A_k·inv(k), factorial fact=(N-1)!, then answer each query u<v as fact * ( C[u-1] + (u≥2 ? A_u·(1-inv[u]) : 0) + B[v-1] - B[u] + A_v ) mod 998244353, with fast I/O

Cross-check implementation against brute-force enumeration of all (N-1)! trees for small N (≤6) and against Sample 3, covering edge cases N=2, u=1, adjacent vertices, large A_i — all passed, including exact rational verification of Sample 3 query 1 (55973424)
